CITY OF ALHAMBRA DESIGN REVIEW BOARD
  ACTION MINUTES

  Regular Meeting
  December 9, 2025

A.  CALL MEETING TO ORDER:  7:00 P.M. in Conference Room A of Alhambra City Hall.

B.  ROLL CALL:

  Present:  Ankit Udani, Vice Chairman; Michael Daninger; Stanley Tsai; Jennifer Ng

  Absent:  Nora Hernandez, Chairman

  Staff Present: Steve Kuchenski, Secretary/City Architect; Eric Martinez, City Architect
  Representative

C.  CONSENT AGENDA:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 1:  MINUTES – November 25, 2025
  • Request: This is a request for the Design Review Board to approve
  the Minutes of the November 25, 2025, Regular Meeting of the
  Design Review Board.
  • Recommended Action: Design Review Board review and approve
  as submitted the Minutes of the November 25, 2025, Regular Meeting
  of the Design Review Board.

  MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve Consent Agenda Item 1.
  •  Moved by Board Member Daninger, Seconded by Board Member Ng.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 4-0-0-1
  Ayes:  Udani, Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  Hernandez

D.  DISCUSSION ITEMS:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 2:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-25-048
  • 1500 West Hellman Avenue
  • Applicant: Jose Moreno
  • Request: This is an application for a new front and side yard wall,
  fence, and pedestrian gates on an existing single-family residential
  lot.

  1
  12/09/2025
   •  Recommended Action: APPROVE. The proposed project is
  approved without conditions.

MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve the application without conditions.
  •  Moved by Board Member Ng, Seconded by Board Member Daninger.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 4-0-0-1
  Ayes:  Udani, Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  Hernandez

AGENDA
ITEM 3:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-25-107
  • 1645 West Valley Boulevard, Unit A
  • Applicant: Kaizen Chen and Alison Fung
  • Request: This is an application for a new recessed entry door, trash
  enclosure, and mechanical room screening on an existing 1-story
  commercial building for a new commercial tenant known as “Qzone
  Billiards Hall.”
  • Recommended Action: APPROVE. The proposed project is
  approved without conditions.

MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve the application without conditions.
  •  Moved by Board Member Ng, Seconded by Board Member Daninger.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 4-0-0-1
  Ayes:  Udani, Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  Hernandez

AGENDA
ITEM 4:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-25-121
  • 17 West Main Street
  • Applicant: Min Kim
  • Request: This is an application for a new wall sign along the rear
  façade of an existing commercial building for an existing restaurant
  tenant known as “Eat’s AYCE Sushi.”
  • Recommended Action: APPROVE WITH CONDITIONS - The
  proposed project is approved with the following Conditions of
  Approval:
  1. The applicant shall revise the description of the return depth
  to indicate a 3-inch depth on page 1 of the signage packet.

  2
  12/09/2025
 MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve the application with the following Conditions of
  Approval:
  1. The applicant shall revise the description of the return depth
  to indicate a 3-inch depth on page 1 of the signage packet.

  •  Moved by Board Member Ng, Seconded by Board Member Tsai.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 4-0-0-1
  Ayes:  Udani, Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  Hernandez

AGENDA
ITEM 5:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-25-143
  • 412 East Main Street
  • Applicant: Bob Packham & Ted Slaught
  • Request: This is an application for new commercial building signage
  and the re-facing of an existing parking lot monument sign for the new
  commercial tenant known as “UFC Gym.”
  • Recommended Action: APPROVE WITH CONDITIONS - The
  proposed project is approved with the following Conditions of
  Approval:
  1. The applicant shall apply a white and off-white paint color for
  the cornice element of the existing monument sign to maintain
  a color consistency with the building’s cornice detail.

MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve the application with the following Conditions of
  Approval:
  1. The applicant shall apply a white and off-white paint color for
  the cornice element of the existing monument sign to
  maintain a color consistency with the building’s cornice
  detail.
  2. On page 2 of the signage packet, correct the location of the
  callout for sign #2.2.

  •  Moved by Board Member Ng, Seconded by Board Member Daninger.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 4-0-0-1
  Ayes:  Udani, Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  Hernandez

  3
  12/09/2025
   AGENDA ITEM NO. 1

  AGENDA
  ITEM 6:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-25-087
  • 110 South Chapel Avenue
  • Applicant: William Yang
  • Request: This is an application for a new 6-story, 80,113 SF, 60-unit
  multi-family residential development with four levels of residential
  units above two levels of parking, along with various common areas
  and substantial open spaces both on grade and at podium level.
  • Recommended Action: APPROVE. The proposed project is
  approved without conditions.

  MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve the application with the following Conditions of
  Approval:
  1. The applicant shall correct the typo error on Sheet AO. 7 where
  the same floor label is incorrectly identified twice.

  •  Moved by Board Member Ng, Seconded by Board Member Tsai.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 4-0-0-1
  Ayes:  Udani, Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  Hernandez

E.  ORAL COMMUNICATIONS:

  •  There were no Oral Communications.

F.  ADJOURNMENT:

  •  There being no other business, the meeting was adjourned at 8:02 P.M. to
  Tuesday, December 23, 2025, at 7:00 P.M.

  Vice Chairman
ATTEST:

Steve Kuchenski
Secretary/City Architect
